items.title: Central Bank Holds Policy Rate Steady Amid Declining Inflation
items.summary: The Central Bank of The Gambia has maintained its policy rate at 15% as inflation eases to single digits for the first time in two years.
items.author: Amadou Bah

items.title: IEC Completes Voter Registration Update, Adds 85,000 New Voters
items.summary: The Independent Electoral Commission has concluded its nationwide voter registration update, adding 85,000 newly eligible voters ahead of the 2026 general elections.
items.author: Ebrima Sillah

items.title: Agriculture Ministry Distributes Climate-Resilient Seeds for 2025 Rainy Season
items.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture has distributed drought-resistant groundnut and rice seed varieties to 8,000 farming households ahead of the 2025 planting season.
items.author: Ousman Darboe

items.title: Gambian Diaspora Professionals Launch Virtual Mentorship Platform
items.summary: A network of 150 Gambian professionals abroad has launched an online platform offering free career mentorship to young graduates at home.
items.author: Sarjo Camara
